title: nCoV-2019 Sequencing Protocol for Single Sample
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdbfi2jn

steps.title: Prepare Template RNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the viral RNA input from a clinical sample based on Ct values to reduce PCR-inhibition.

substeps.instruction: If Ct is 18-35, use as is.
If Ct is 12-15, dilute the sample 100-fold in water.
If Ct is 15-18, dilute the sample 10-fold in water.

steps.title: Perform RNA Denaturation
steps.instruction: Mix the following components in an 0.2mL 8-strip tube in the mastermix cabinet (wipe tubes when entering/leaving):

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL 50µM random hexamers
Add 1 µL 10mM dNTPs mix (10mM each)
Add 11 µL Template RNA (Total volume: 13 µL)
Gently mix by pipetting and pulse spin the tube to collect liquid at the bottom
Incubate at 65 °C for 00:05:00
Place on ice for 00:01:00

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Add the following components to the annealed template RNA in the extraction and sample addition cabinet (prepare mastermix in the mastermix cabinet and wipe tubes when entering/leaving):

substeps.instruction: Add 4 µL SSIV Buffer
Add 1 µL 100mM DTT
Add 1 µL RNaseOUT RNase Inhibitor
Add 1 µL SSIV Reverse Transcriptase (Total volume: 20 µL)
Gently mix by pipetting and pulse spin the tube to collect liquid at the bottom
Incubate at 42 °C for 00:50:00
Incubate at 70 °C for 00:10:00
Hold at 5 °C

steps.title: Prepare Primer Pool Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare primer pools in the mastermix cabinet (clean with decontamination wipes and UV sterilize before and after use).

substeps.instruction: If required, resuspend lyophilised nCov-2019/V2 primers at 100µM each
Generate Pool 1 (100µM) and Pool 2 (100µM) by adding 5 µL of each primer pair to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube to a total volume of 490 µL per pool
Dilute each primer pool 1:10 in molecular grade water to generate 10µM primer stocks (create multiple aliquots)

steps.title: Set Up Multiplex PCR
steps.instruction: Set up multiplex PCR reactions in 0.2mL 8-strip PCR tubes in the mastermix hood (prepare mastermix in cabinet and wipe tubes when entering/leaving).

substeps.instruction: For each pool (Pool 1 and Pool 2), add: 5 µL 5X Q5 Reaction Buffer, 0.5 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 0.25 µL Q5 Hot Start DNA Polymerase, 3.6 µL Primer Pool (10µM), and 13.15 µL Nuclease-free water (Total volume: 22.5 µL)
In the extraction and sample addition cabinet (clean with decontamination wipes and UV sterilize before and after use), add 2.5 µL cDNA to each tube and mix well by pipetting
Pulse centrifuge the tubes to collect contents at the bottom

steps.title: Amplify cDNA
steps.instruction: Run the following program on the thermal cycler:

substeps.instruction: Heat Activation: 98 °C for 00:00:30 (1 cycle)
Denaturation: 98 °C for 00:00:15 (25-35 cycles)
Annealing: 65 °C for 00:05:00 (25-35 cycles)
Hold: 4 °C Indefinite
Set cycle number to 25 for Ct 18-21, up to a maximum of 35 cycles for Ct 35

steps.title: Pool and Clean Amplicons
steps.instruction: Combine and purify the PCR products in the post-PCR cabinet (clean with decontamination wipes and UV sterilize before and after use).

substeps.instruction: Combine the entire contents of Pool 1 and Pool 2 PCR reactions for each biological sample into a single 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube
Clean-up amplicons using SPRI beads (following Josh Quick protocol)

steps.title: Quantify and Normalize DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify the amplicon pools using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay.

substeps.instruction: If concentration is > 25 ng/µL, dilute the sample 10-fold by adding 270µL 10mM Tris and quantify again
Normalize input by diluting each sample to 5 ng/µL

steps.title: Perform End-Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA for ligation using the Ultra II module.

substeps.instruction: Perform end-preparation on the single amplicon pool using the Ultra II End Repair/dA-Tailing module (use 10 µL input to provide 50 ng total)
Clean-up the end-preparation reaction using a 1x volume of SPRI beads and elute in 30 µL Elution Buffer (EB)

steps.title: Ligate Adapters
steps.instruction: Perform adapter ligation on the single amplicon pool using AMX (one-pot ligation protocol for native barcoded libraries).

substeps.instruction: Process at least 7 samples plus one negative control per native barcoded library

steps.title: Final Library Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the final library using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay.

substeps.instruction: Store final library in 10 mM Tris pH 8 at 4°C for up to a week if not sequencing immediately

steps.title: Sequence on MinION
steps.instruction: Load the library onto the flowcell and start sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Prime the flowcell
Load 20 ng of sequencing library onto the flowcell
Start the sequencing run using MinKNOW
